extension_name.description: Extension name shown in Safari. Keep it identical in every locale.

extension_description.message: Hide Shorts from the YouTube website in Safari.
extension_description.description: Extension description shown in Safari settings.

popup_description.message: Hide YouTube Shorts while you browse
popup_description.description: One-line summary at the top of the popup.

popup_status_active.description: Status pill shown while the extension runs.

toggle_shorts_description.message: Hide YouTube Shorts in Safari (on by default).

toggle_home_description.message: Leave the Home feed blank without redirecting to another page.

toggle_recommendations_description.message: Remove related videos around the player on watch pages.

stats_shorts_hidden.description: Counter of Shorts hidden on this device. $COUNT$ is a formatted number.

rating_title.description: Title of the App Store rating card.

rating_body.message: A quick rating on the App Store helps other people find it.
rating_body.description: Body of the App Store rating card.

rating_button.description: Button that opens the App Store review page.

rating_later.description: Button that hides the rating card for a while.

bundle_text.message: Use Instagram or X in Safari too?
bundle_text.description: Cross-sell line for the bundle with the Instagram and X extensions.

bundle_link.description: Link to the App Store bundle.

support_text.message: Need help or found a bug?

contact_link.description: Footer button that emails the developer.

response_time.description: Footer reassurance under the contact button.

toggle_community_description.message: Hide text and image posts from the Home feed.

pin_note.message: Optionally require a PIN to change settings in this popup on this device. Keep it safe. Safari can still disable or remove the extension.

pin_invalid.message: Enter the same PIN twice, using 4 to 12 digits.

pin_saved.message: PIN saved. Enter it to change your settings.

pin_wait.message: Too many attempts. Please wait 30 seconds and try again.

pin_unlocked.message: Settings unlocked until this popup closes.

pin_storage_error.message: The PIN could not be checked or saved. Reopen the extension and try again.

settings_save_error.message: Settings could not be saved. Please reopen the extension and try again.

save_unknown.message: Save not yet confirmed. Wait, or reopen this popup to check the stored state.

storage_read_error.message: Stored settings could not be read. Reopen the extension and try again.

pin_invalid_data.message: The stored PIN data could not be read. Settings remain locked. Please contact support.

pin_locked.message: Settings are locked. Enter your PIN to make changes.

pin_changed.message: The PIN changed in another window. Use the current PIN to unlock settings.

pin_crypto_unavailable.message: PIN protection is unavailable in this Safari context. Please update Safari or reopen the extension.

pin_save_unknown.message: Save not yet confirmed. Keep your PIN safe and wait, or reopen this popup to check the stored state.

pin_removed_elsewhere.message: The PIN was removed in another window. Settings are unlocked.

pin_removed_retry.message: The PIN was removed in another window. Your change was not saved; please try it again.

popup_locale.description: Metadata for popup language, selected by the same i18n message bundle as the visible copy. Not user-facing text.

popup_direction.description: Metadata for popup reading direction. Keep aligned with this locale; not user-facing text.
